question: What is the national diabetes prevalence by year?
sql: SELECT g.survey_year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(g.weighted_yes_sum) / SUM(g.weighted_valid_sum), 2) AS prevalence_pct FROM brfss.gold.diabetes_prevalence_state g GROUP BY g.survey_year ORDER BY g.survey_year

question: Which 10 states have the highest diabetes prevalence?
sql: SELECT g.state_name, g.survey_year, ROUND(g.prevalence_weighted_pct, 2) AS prevalence_pct, g.valid_respondents FROM brfss.gold.diabetes_prevalence_state g ORDER BY g.prevalence_weighted_pct DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many records were quarantined and why?
sql: SELECT q.rule_id, COUNT(*) AS quarantined_rows FROM brfss.silver.quarantine q GROUP BY q.rule_id ORDER BY quarantined_rows DESC

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- Always state which survey year or years the answer covers.
- Round percentages to two decimal places.
- Never average state prevalence values; combine weighted_yes_sum and weighted_valid_sum instead.
